title: use player defeated sprite with auto revive and nonblocking level-up
problem_statement: Current Pi-Chan death flow uses game-over interruption/continue UI instead of showing the new defeated sprite and reviving in place after a short standby.
game_flow_context: player death / continue / revive / level transition / visual feedback
scope_inputs: user request: player defeated asset and auto revive
validated_decisions: Use existing continue budget as finite auto-revive limit.
Normalize source player_defeated asset into runtime collage asset.
Do not change scoring, wave model, level data, collision radius, or movement speed.
draft_assumptions_in_play: A short post-revive grace window is needed to prevent immediate repeated death in the same position.
Game-over overlay remains only when auto-continues are exhausted.
current_direction: Add player defeated asset to manifest/preload.
Draw defeated Pi-Chan with new sprite.
Replace immediate game-over stop on player hit with defeated standby and automatic revive while continues remain.
explicit_non_goals: No collision radius or movement speed changes.
backward_compatibility_concerns: auto revive changes death flow; keep continue budget finite
same-position revive needs brief grace window
human_test_checklist: player killed by bullet enters defeated standby
player killed by onion enters defeated standby
player revives in same position after delay
no blocking game-over UI before continues are exhausted
new defeated sprite has clean transparency/scaling
decision_log_summary: LOG-001: task-orchestrator approved scoped build for player defeated auto-revive flow.
